verdict.comment: The vote goes to RANGATIRA JACK who made his breakthrough with a dominant display at Exeter and is open to more progress over fences.

comments.abingworth: Clearcut win at Wincanton and he still looks feasibly treated off revised mark; key player
comments.carrigmoornarowan: Didn't progress over hurdles and was a remote fifth on chase debut (3m, good) last month
comments.davidoc: Point/hurdle winner; still has potential over fences and he's in the mix back up in trip
comments.flashgorcombe: Dominant display at Exeter in January but he's been disappointing in three runs since
comments.gladiatus: Fair third at Wincanton but was 9l behind Abingworth and he's out of the weights here
comments.godsowngetaway: On dangerous mark on this step back up in trip but he needs to rediscover his spark
comments.grillondemonty: Has struggled since returning from a long absence in December and can only be watched
comments.kaycedutton: Runner-up in four of his last five starts including at Stratford latest; respected
comments.oakleydancer: Pulled up in two runs during the winter and needs a major revival with cheekpieces added
comments.rangatirajack: Off the mark with 6l win at Exeter; up 7lb but he's open to more progress over fences

races.raceComment: abingworth is marginally preferred with a score of 54.4%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and more progressive over davidoc. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The strongest contenders on form are BIG BOY BARNEY, Orderoftheday, Pioneer Pete and Roll Tide in that order of preference.

comments.crystaldays: Needs a boost from physical tweak (had wind surgery since last run)
comments.doubletiger: Has a useful pedigree and should do well in bumpers; interesting newcomer
comments.freshkicks: Went close in second attempt in Irish points; heed the market signals
comments.gollygosh: 20,000euros 3yo; out of a chase winner; others preferred
comments.hairypotter: Last of seven at Southwell, failing to back up his C&D effort
comments.iceintheveins: 87,000euros 3yo; half-brother to two winners over jumps; has had wind surgery
comments.jolliedame: £100,000 3yo; half-sister to a bumper/hurdle winner; likely sort
comments.latenightstory: Pedigree suggests he's one for further down the line
comments.loubard: Doesn't look an obvious type on breeding
comments.nightridehome: Didn't live up to market expectations at Kempton but seems likely to do better
comments.orderoftheday: Irish point winner; creditable second in both rules runs, latest at Wetherby; solid claims
comments.pioneerpete: Promising second of 11 in newcomers' event at this course; clear possibilities
comments.queensworthy: Finished 14l second in Irish point; siblings include a bumper scorer
comments.rolltide: Promising third of seven at Doncaster; Harry Cobden is booked; open to improvement

verdict.comment: Thunder Star should go well again but SOUTH PARADE was improving last summer and can continue on her upward trajectory this year.

comments.brummell: C&D win last May; impressed on AW in November; less good over 6f latest; drying ground a ?
comments.burningcash: Capable off this mark and well drawn; nine-month absence to deal with but not ruled out
comments.copperknight: Admirable veteran but yet to shine at Beverley and likely to come on for seasonal return
comments.digital: On a handy mark & shaped quite well on his return; return to 5f a plus but drawn wide
comments.emeraldspride: Goes well here but she has the widest stall and a career-high mark to contend with
comments.fierce: Promising stable debut last month (5f, AW; first run after wind op); tricky draw today
comments.gloriousangel: Quiet on AW this year but down in class on return to turf; good or slower suits her best
comments.highopinion: Won three 5f turf handicaps last year; returns from six-month break in a competitive race
comments.minnesotalad: C&D winner; retains ability for this yard and returning to 5f shouldn't be a problem
comments.projectdante: Should be sharper with his reappearance behind him; return of blinkers a plus; wide stall
comments.southparade: Good progress in the second half of 2024; more to come this year; big player from low draw
comments.thankuappreciate: Ended 2024 in good form on AW; modest strike-rate on turf though; can miss the break
comments.thunderstar: Ended losing run with a good win in a big field at Doncaster last month; solid claims
comments.ticktyboo: Well held in two handicaps following a three-runner maiden win; slower than good ideal
comments.zuffolo: Low-key reappearance but blinkers return today and he's well drawn; one for the shortlist

races.raceComment: thunderstar is marginally preferred with a score of 56.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more reliable profile over fierce. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 4 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for TWO B TANNED, who bolted up over C&D last week in first-time cheekpieces and is able to run off just 3lb higher today.

comments.alsuileile: Has a better strike-rate on AW than turf but could nevertheless have a part to play
comments.crowdquake: No surprise if he displays major improvement now up in trip off basement opening mark
comments.heycrackers: Down the field in his 3 qualifying races & same story at triple-figure odds in both h'caps
comments.icantbelieve: Won at Wolverhampton in January but down the field there the last twice
comments.mrheinz: Won at Newcastle last September but has modest strike-rate and returns from a break
comments.mrjetman: Poor strike-rate but in good form since joining this yard and could be bang there
comments.panamacity: Better on AW but handicapped accordingly on turf and went close on AW last time
comments.thatsmyboyluke: Well beaten the last twice and now 0-11 but the change of headgear could be a positive
comments.twobtanned: Easily made all in first-time cheekpieces over C&D last week; could take plenty of beating
comments.waitandhope: Runner-up over C&D last June off 13lb higher but has struggled subsequently
comments.zousjuice: Yet to threaten but ran okay at Doncaster last month and the first-time visor may help

races.raceComment: twobtanned is marginally preferred with a score of 54.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive over panamacity. Won 1 of last 4 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Rich Rhythm and SECRET STRENGTH appeal most and the latter can capitalise on the drop in class and return to Polytrack.

comments.chifa: Fine return from lengthy absence when 3rd at Wolverhampton last month; not so good latest
comments.flagofstgeorge: Running creditably in stronger 1m handicaps this year; one to consider dropped in class
comments.futurecutlet: Promise in Ireland but he made a low-key stable debut at Kempton this month; sharper today
comments.gdaay: Caught wide when 4th at Lingfield latest; second over C&D on penultimate run; back up 3lb
comments.nammos: Two C&D wins last year; promising return to action three weeks ago; handy mark; yard run 2
comments.richrhythm: In good form this winter and he remains feasibly treated; should make another bold bid
comments.roguesoldier: Two wins for former stables; sold £1,000 in September; best watched after nine months off
comments.secretstrength: Coaxed back to form by new yard; Rossa Ryan booked for his return to Class 5; respected
comments.vinatera: Third in two 7f Polytrack events before finding 6f too sharp last time; handicap debut

races.raceComment: nammos is marginally preferred with a score of 53.0%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions over richrhythm. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 6 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Triggered and Thomas Equinas can feature prominently but STACEY RACEY is back to a dangerous mark and could be the answer.

comments.dashingdonkey: Two turf wins last season but also effective over C&D; well drawn but absent for 5 months
comments.fatgladiator: Ran well after long layoff in March; less good without hood since but headgear returns now
comments.kessaarpower: Prominent racer with a handy draw; goes well at Chelmsford; each-way shout
comments.mashaan: Returning to 7f is a positive but he's now 9lb higher than for last month's Lingfield win
comments.mitigator: Low-key stable debut/reappearance 12 days ago (1m2f, good); best watched over 7f
comments.overlooked: 14-race maiden but capable at a modest level and he's dropping down the weights
comments.scarletlady: Disappointing since an easy Yarmouth win last summer, including when well backed latest
comments.shotoflove: Run to form in just one of his six starts for this yard; others have more pressing claims
comments.southkensington: Well held at big prices in two runs for new yard; down in class; market should guide
comments.staceyracey: Two AW handicap wins in 2024; not at best so far in 2025 but capable of better; contender
comments.thomasequinas: Conditions to suit and this is less demanding than last week's C&D assignment; considered
comments.triggered: Veteran on a losing run of 18 but conditions suit and he ran well over C&D last week

races.raceComment: thomasequinas is marginally preferred with a score of 52.4%. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

form.rpCloseUpComment: dwelt start, in rear throughout, no chance when not clear run inside final furlong (An inquiry was held into the running and riding of Hala Joza, ridden by Darragh Keenan and trained by Martin Dunne, which jumped awkwardly before being restrained from stall 10 to race in rear throughout and staying on fairly in the home straight under considerate handling to finish eighth of eight runners,  beaten 8½ lengths. The rider was interviewed and shown recordings of the race and the Veterinary Officer  examined the filly post-race and had nothing to report. The rider stated that, from his wide draw, his instructions were to get in and sit halfway down the field and to ride his race from there. He stated that his filly was a little slow into stride and whilst he wanted to drop in, there was some interference on his inside so he elected to stay wide and clear of any trouble. He went on to say that this left him three wide and further back than ideal, so he opted to drop in and hope to follow Miss Campanella through but that filly was running green and did not carry him into the race as hoped. He added that once in the straight when he had intended to ask Hala Joza for her full effort and obtain clear running, he was impeded by Blue Force One which had lugged right-handed into his path and resulted in him having to take avoiding action, which he reported at the scales. He went on to say that he had advised connections the filly might improve for a step up in trip and being ridden more prominently. His explanation was noted.)
